_comment: S5 segment-assignment behavioral fixture. Each customer's AVG-BAL tests a band or a band boundary. 5-band thresholds (D-1102, source-invisible): SG01 [0,1M) / SG02 [1M,5M) / SG03 [5M,20M) / SG04 [20M,50M) / SG05 [50M,inf). Tie-break (D-1103): boundary value -> HIGHER segment (lower bound inclusive). expect_seg = GOLDEN expectation. START does a single compare (>=5M->SG03 else SG01), so it mis-assigns SG02/SG04/SG05 customers. The B*-at-boundary rows pin the LOWER-inclusive edge (1M->SG02 etc.); the E*-just-below rows pin the UPPER-exclusive edge ([lower,upper)), so a `>`/`>=` off-by-one on either side fails a criterion.
